integrity: The parameter formula and minimizer count are proved from the exact shore-sum constraints. The proof isolates every possible total weight below four and classifies all weight-four support patterns, including the small exceptional cases. The standalone checker exhaustively verifies small graphs and minimum-function counts.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to complete bipartite graphs with a matching deleted. It does not treat arbitrary edge deletions or enumerate nonminimum perfect Italian dominating functions. The finite checker is a stress test rather than the basis of the universal proof.
title: Perfect Italian domination after matching deletion in complete bipartite graphs
